title: Quantum Foundations
description: Everything is a wave until it is measured. Catalogue phenomena with the Spectral Analyzer to begin.

puzzle.goal: A particle of mass m moves along a line through a potential V(x), and it is described not by a position but by a complex wave ψ(x, t). Write how that wave changes in time: the left side is iħ times its rate of change, the right side is the energy operator acting on it; kinetic energy from the curvature of ψ, plus the potential.
puzzle.name: Time-dependent Schrödinger equation (one dimension)
puzzle.ask: For V = 0 a plane wave e^{i(kx−ωt)} solves it with momentum p = ħk = mv, so its wavelength is λ = 2π/k = h/(mv). Find λ in nm for an electron, with h in units of 1e-34 J s, m in 1e-31 kg and v in 1e6 m/s (the unit factors combine to exactly 1 nm).
puzzle.method: Kinetic energy is p²/2m with momentum acting as −iħ ∂/∂x, so p² becomes −ħ² ∂²/∂x²; add the potential energy as a multiplier.
